verdicts.note: Checked although verify=false: Capriccio (Concert Rondo) in C major, B. 81, c.1878; IMSLP and Bärenreiter Praha Urtext; first printed Breitkopf 1929 (ed. G. Raphael); on Supraphon 2024 complete violin & piano set. Key is C major (not G minor).

Exists as titled: Nocturne in B major, Op. 40, B. 48a is Dvořák's own violin & piano version of the string Nocturne B. 47 (1883); the composer-catalogue site gives first edition Bote & Bock, Berlin 1883 (Wikipedia names Simrock 1883 for the work in general) and a duration of about 9 min (queued 7). Recorded on the Supraphon 2024 complete violin & piano set.

verdicts.title: Indian Lament in G minor, from Sonatina Op. 100 (arr. Kreisler)
verdicts.note: Kreisler's arrangement of the Larghetto of the Sonatina Op. 100 exists: New York, Charles Foley 1914, plate 13562 (Carl Fischer imprint); key G minor per Kreisler work list; recorded by Kreisler (Victor 1914, 1928). Title only adds the key and tidies the style.

verdicts.title: Slavonic Fantasie in B minor (arr. Kreisler)
verdicts.note: Exists (Kreisler, Carl Fischer/Foley 1914, plate 13563, dedicated to Carl Flesch; IFK 34) but it is a free fantasy on three Dvořák pieces: Songs My Mother Taught Me (Gypsy Songs Op. 55 No. 4), Humoresque Op. 101 No. 8 and Romantic Piece Op. 75 No. 1 - no dance themes. Kreisler's own spelling is 'Slavonic Fantasie'. The same piece is queued as N8 in kreisler-fritz.json - dedupe and keep one entry. Level may deserve 7 (free virtuoso fantasy).

Exists: Gavotte in G minor for three violins, B. 164 (1890, not 1879), first printed in the children's periodical 'Mladý houslista' (Vilímek, Prague 1890); Bärenreiter Praha H3392-01 (with Miniatures Op. 75a), about 3 min. Accompaniment should be '2 violins' (two further violins), not 'Unaccompanied'. Easy piece written for young players - level 1-2.

gaps.title: Negro Spiritual Melody (after the Largo of Symphony No. 9, Op. 95 'From the New World', arr. Kreisler)
gaps.edition: New York: Charles Foley, 1924 (reprinted Carl Fischer in '8 Original Pieces and Arrangements', plate 23225); recorded by Kreisler (Victor 1122, 1925)
gaps.note: Abridged arrangement of the Largo in D-flat major; probably also belongs on Kreisler's list - dedupe across composers.

existing_issues.issue: Title lacks the key: Kreisler's Slavonic Dance No. 3 is in G major (a transposition of Op. 72 No. 8, originally A-flat major).
existing_issues.suggested_title: Slavonic Dance No. 3 in G major, Op. 72 No. 8 (arr. Kreisler)

existing_issues.issue: Sources disagree on the original of Kreisler's Slavonic Dance No. 1 in G minor: IMSLP/Wikipedia give Op. 46 No. 2 (Wikipedia: also Op. 72 No. 1), Carl Fischer's Kreisler Collection lists it as after Op. 46 No. 8 (the G minor Furiant). Title is as IMSLP gives it; check the printed edition before changing.
Optional: the Ballade is catalogued Op. 15 No. 1, B. 139 (Op. 15 is the set number on the composer's work page).
